ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: TEXT(LeadSource) <> 'Broker Portal' && (NOT(ISBLANK(BrokerAgency__c)) || NOT(ISBLANK(BrokerAgent__c)) || NOT(ISBLANK(BrokerAgentMobile__c)) || NOT(ISBLANK(BrokerAgentName__c))) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, 'Modon - Egypt'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Following fields should be blank if Lead Source is NOT Broker Portal: Broker Agency, Broker Agent, Broker Agent Mobile, Broker Agent Name.
